Input roles: Image 1: source crop: exact Aa/globe/brush/shield and control geometry. Image 2: Japanese mock: authoritative 366x588 frame, layout and exact labels. Image 3: approved forest-green visual direction.
Use case: precise settings-sheet reconstruction. Image 1 controls source icon anatomy. Image 2 is authoritative for the exact 366x588 layout, Japanese copy and scale. Recreate it faithfully with source-correct controls.
Target geometry: outer frame 366x588; title at x16 y30; first section heading x16 y80; first white group x16 y106 w334 h240; dropdown fields x28 w322 h40 at y178 and y294; second section heading x16 y364; second group x16 y390 w334 h129; theme selector x270 y410 w80 h38; action x16 y532 w334 h40, with 16px bottom margin. Each first-group icon is centered x37, with labels/helpers starting x58. Specifically Language uses the source Aa letter icon, Region uses a globe; do not duplicate globe. The lower group uses brush and shield icons at x28, with labels starting x58. Selector has three tight controls: sun, moon, high-contrast, with the third selected. Use one compact outer sheet, two inset white groups and the full-width green action. Adapt purple source accents to Lighthouse forest green. Use slate for unselected symbols and chevrons. Keep text exact: クイック設定; 言語と地域; 表示言語; ボタンや案内の表示に使用します。; 英語（英国）; 地域; 検索結果に使用する地域です。; 米国; 検索の設定; テーマ; 表示方法を選びます。; 安全な検索; 露骨な内容を除外します。; すべての設定. No oversized surfaces, icons, excessive spacing, shadows or browser/phone chrome.
